dedupe_keys.name: supporting github integrating data engineering and process systems engineering for end of life chemical flow analysis

description: TRI4PLADS is the code archive supporting an end-of-life chemical-flow analysis by José D. Hernandez-Betancur and colleagues from Universidad Nacional de Colombia, the US Environmental Protection Agency and Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University. The described workflow combines data engineering, data-driven models and process systems engineering to trace chemicals across waste-management processes. Methyl methacrylate supplies the worked example, including potential redistribution, releases and exposure pathways. Zenodo preserves the March 2025 version 1.0.0 GitHub release as a ZIP archive under MIT, free of charge. Coverage and resolution depend on the regulatory inputs; the deposit does not specify a complete reporting period. Reporting variability and missing facility or equipment details limit the accuracy of release estimates. A modeller could reuse the workflow when representing industrial-waste dependencies. It was not executed, and no related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
